multi_entity_note: Two parties (Go Call, Inc. and PageMaster Corporation) with two addresses; third parties MetroCall and Motorola mentioned.
processing_note: Such notice or demand shall be deemed to have been given or made when actually received or seventy-two (72) hours after being sent, whichever occurs first.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and opening sentence name it the Promotion Agreement; the heading line also carries party names, which belong to another value.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is 'dated March 12,1999'; the 3/13/99 signature dates are a different (signing) date and other dates are term/offer deadlines.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Section 3 says the promotion Term begins on June 1,1999; other June 1, 1999 mentions are the hotline and exclusivity periods.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Section 3 says the Term terminates June 1, 2000 (extendable); the same date in 4(e) is an exclusivity period end and March 26, 1999 is an offer deadline.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 11 applies the laws of the State of California; Los Angeles County is the place of performance/venue.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Section 3: the term shall be extended for a 1 year period provided 3000 pagers per month are distributed.

contract.notice_period.rationale: The extension is conditional on volume; no notice to prevent renewal is stated.
